title: ActionLine
description: One line of actions.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): one call JavaScript made to the capture module during the session, with what native code returned. The recorder's plumbing (appendBoundary, listRecordings, exportRecording, deleteRecording) is never logged. A value that would pass the JSON-text bound or the line limit is replaced by the marker {"omitted":"too_large","bytes":N}. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t never decreases, args and result parse as JSON, and call is not a plumbing call.

t.description: When native code answered the call.

call.description: The method's name, for example markAnchor.

args.description: The arguments as JavaScript passed them, as JSON text (an array).

result.description: What native code returned, as JSON text, or null for nothing or for a binary result (which only boundary/<seq>.f32 holds).

error.description: The error's code when the call failed, else null.
